mentions.name: okular-mupdf-ng
mentions.description: A project to reduce the attack surface of Linux document readers, starting with Okular, by sandboxing the most dangerous components: the document parser and renderer.
mentions.problem: Linux document readers have a large attack surface, with the document parser and renderer being the most dangerous components.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I've been working on a project to reduce attack surface of Linux document readers, starting with Okular: https://github.com/l4rzy/okular-mupdf-ng

The idea is to sandbox the most dangerous parts of it: The Document parser and renderer.
